_readme: Optional glTF/GLB overrides for procedural models. Put the .glb next to this file and add an entry, e.g. "palm": { "url": "palm.glb", "scale": 1, "rotY": 0 }. Keys: car, palm, tree, shrub, streetlight, hydrant, wire (barbed wire: one coil 1 m long along X, stretched to the wire's length). Models are in metres, +Y up, facing +Z. Only use models whose licence allows it (CC0 recommended).
